study: round 5, vortexexam (track 2): exam pilot on the fed-vortex world

r5-vortexexam-004.why: invalid request: purpose line over 300 characters; resubmitted as r5-vortexexam-005

r5-vortexexam-005.why: infra_error at provisioning: cap $19.40 was 0.1 cent under $6.69/h x (2.65 + 0.25) h; no job time; resubmitted as r5-vortexexam-006 with cap $19.60

value.H_rule: largest size with >= 100.0 member-ticks/s (444 at B=1024)

throughput.note: member-ticks per second, float64 world with the vortex tracker, jax.vmap batch B; one tick = 250 native steps = 5 time units

law.note: x(t+16) - x(t) = b1 x(1-x) + b2 (1-2x) + e per eps, pooled over members and ticks >= 64; b1_line: weighted straight line b1 = c0 + c1 eps over the eps values; b1_proportional: b1 = c eps; b1_line_eps_positive: the line fitted without eps = 0 (chi2 against the member-bootstrap SEs); integrated_law: every member's share at tick 100 iterated with the fitted map every 16 ticks to tick 436 (1,680 time units), error of the ensemble mean; out_of_sample: constants fitted on the first half of the members, applied to the second half (z against the SE of that half's mean)

scan.source: results/analysis1.json scan (analyse1.py on job r5-vortexexam-002: scan_main.npz, scan_branch_small.npz)
scan.note: headroom = theta-plug-in deficit / D_h of the null setting; L2 = mean over h 8, 16, 32 ticks of level 2 (N, s_b); L1 = mean over h 1, 2, 4, 8 of the block raster of the vortex list; L2_se, L1_se = SE over the (member, anchor) states of the setting; viability entries: [viable members, of, mean N, min N, max N]; paired_shift_z_main_runs: paired z of trajectory statistics against the null setting (z of N at ticks 100 on and of s_b at ticks 250 on, lo and hi edge; max |z| over 9 statistics)

scan2.source: results/analysis1.json scan2 (analyse1.py on the --scan-only rerun (r5-vortexexam-003 out/scan), scan_branch.npz)
scan2.note: headroom = theta-plug-in deficit / D_h of the null setting; L2 = mean over h 8, 16, 32 ticks of level 2 (N, s_b); L1 = mean over h 1, 2, 4, 8 of the block raster of the vortex list; L2_se, L1_se = SE over the (member, anchor) states of the setting; viability entries: [viable members, of, mean N, min N, max N]; paired_shift_z_main_runs: paired z of trajectory statistics against the null setting (z of N at ticks 100 on and of s_b at ticks 250 on, lo and hi edge; max |z| over 9 statistics); NOISY: under 12 states per setting (this rerun shrank to its smallest design: the Mac's review of r5-vortexexam-003), level-1 climatology from J - 1 other members

viability.rule: fields finite, no tracker overflow, n_min <= N <= K - 1 at every state from t_from on

selection.basis: proxy: max |paired z| of N, s_b early, s_b late over the main runs (no branches)
selection.why: d = 4 because the measured throughput (444 member-ticks/s at 128^2) allows a 768-1024 point design; eps, nu and e are the rule's choice on the main-run proxy (selection, flow, fuel); mut128 is added instead of the next family by the proxy (growth: k) because it sets the mutation constant of the level-2 law, which is the study's question

value.mutation: mut128 = time between mutation events per 128 x 128 px of box (declared per unit area); at 128 x 128 px the interval is mut128 x 1

prior_B_rule_on_branch_headroom.note: the declared rule applied to the level-2 plug-in deficits of job 1's branches (available only after job 2 was requested): eps plus the two families with the largest min-edge headroom; everything else as prior.json

truths.note: pilot truths are public by design; never to be reused as an exam

rule.rule: fields finite, no tracker overflow, n_min <= N <= K - 1 at every state from t_from on

identification.note: L1 = summaries of level-1 histories, L2 = of (N, s_b) only; contraction = posterior sd / prior sd per parameter, mean over truths; in90 = share of (truth, parameter) pairs inside the central 90% interval

scores.note: L = mean fair energy score (vw.scoring.energy_fair) over items and the primary cells (level 2 = (N, s_b) jointly, scaled, at h = 8, 16, 32 ticks); OES = (L(K) - L) / (L(K) - L(O)), equal-weight mean over the primary cells (vw.scoring.skill_report); K = the truth's other main runs at the same tick, K0 = design episodes at the same tick (prior climatology), O_noinput = replicates from the hidden state without the test program

acceptance.note: computed by round5/agentenv/evaluator/acceptance.py (shares): sigma = (L(null) - L(C)) / (L(K) - L(C)), null = the better of D@n and P0; rho = (L(P0) - L(S@n)) / (L(P0) - L(C)); one predictor family per row 'family@n'; '|S2' = posterior from level-2 histories only; '|ded' = dedicated models (C = Cded, S = Sded); SE and 5-95% range from the bootstrap clustered by truth; bars sigma >= 0.15 and rho <= 0.7

gaps.note: OES gaps with a paired bootstrap over items (not clustered by truth)

cchg.note: share of the oracle-predictable change reached, (V_change - Ve) / (V_change - Vu), per horizon (rows) and coordinate (N, s_b): V_change = variance of y(a + h) - y(a) about its mean, Vu = within-item replicate variance, Ve = mean squared error of the predictive mean (64 samples); 'pooled' over all items as in round 3 (track1/vortex128), 'within_truth' about each truth's own mean change, summed over truths

by_program_class.note: OES per program class of the test program (a none, b blind, c aimed, d regional); 1 - OES(O_noinput) = the share of the K-to-O skill that needs the test program

scan_only_run.note: sized by the old rate table (one row at B = bmax, linear below): J and the anchors fell back to the smallest design (the Mac's review of r5-vortexexam-003, major point)
